Sets the volume that a bus gets when the scene is applied. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
AudioSceneVolume paused, world, 0.2
```
@param scene  A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error.
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@param volume  As for [AudioBusVolume](AudioBusVolume). Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap When a bus is freed, every scene forgets its volume, so an old scene never changes the bus that gets the same handle later.
